body: src/registry.js: ~/.pman/projects.json (PMAN_HOME override), entries keyed by root path (worktrees of one repo stay separate), locked atomic writes, live availability check. CLI init and every project command register automatically (PMAN_NO_REGISTER=1 disables); pman projects list/add/remove/prune work from any directory and never touch project files. Tests use a temporary PMAN_HOME.
author: claude
